model.name: convnextv2_final
model.note: The model T4.9 chose (results/e15/decision.json), a timm ConvNeXt V2 tiny on 29 classes. Everything under results/e6 and models/e6 is rebuilt when the checkpoint's checksum changes.

crop_note: E4 kept no crop (docs/DECISIONS.md, T4.1 'Crop kept out of serving'), so the segmentation model is not exported or timed. If this becomes true the stages refuse: that path is not built.

calibration.note: Used only if "static" is listed in quantize. field_train: real photos, never scored, unlike the plan's lab_dev (lab photos look unlike phone photos; DECISIONS T5.2 open concern). Allowed: lab_dev, lab_train, field_train. Never field_dev (scored here) or any test split.

scoring_part.note: The refit's own seed and share (configs/e15.json refit): the part of field_dev groups the thresholds were not fitted on.
